name: TeamStarWolf - D3FEND Blind Spots
description: Rule: A live ATT&CK Enterprise technique is in the layer when data/attack/technique_to_d3fend.jsonl has no row for its ID or for an ID it replaced (data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl); the score is the number of ATT&CK groups that use it. Each technique is shown under all of its tactics. Source: data/attack/technique_to_d3fend.jsonl, data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl (group_count). Generated by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py.
